newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank says US$1 bln swapped to baht.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank says US$1 bln swapped to baht.

text.p: Thai central bank governor Rerngchai Marakanond said on Wednesday Thailand enjoyed a net capital inflow this month which reflected easing of earlier pressure on the baht.
He told reporters the Bank of Thailand had bought about $1 billion of US dollars this month from banks and fund importers seeking to swap them into baht.
"The previous fund outflow has stopped," he said.
Local and regional dealers sold baht in late July and early August on speculation that Thailand may choose to devalue the baht to help revive sluggish export growth.

Opposition member of parliament Supachai Panichpakdi said in parliament on Wednesday, during a no-confidence debate against Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa, that the central bank had spent about $1.2 billion in defending the baht through its intervention in local and regional markets.
